_comment: EcoSIM generic discoveries - applies to EcoSIM calibration across sites
_source: adapter-kit v0.1 seed (ai-draft) from the 15 source-cited findings in memory/dev_logs/20260424g_EcoSIM_Codebase_Wiki_Rewrite.md + models/ecosim/curated_seed.yaml. PENDING PI REVIEW before promotion to confidence >= 0.8. | 2026-08-14: 2 VERIFIED entries appended from the R3 c00 pre-flight work (each carries a file:line or a reproduced runtime error; not ai-draft seeds).
_affects_convention: affects lists output-variable names (EcoSIM history vars) or process axes

discoveries.name: EcoSIM hydraulics is Campbell, not van Genuchten/Brooks-Corey
discoveries.description: Soil water retention uses log-log Campbell with an SRP exponent that switches by organic content (mineral 1.00 / semi-organic 0.33 / organic 0.25). K(theta) is a Green-Corey 100-bin numerical integration, and macropores are explicit (Poiseuille).
discoveries.action: Do NOT port CLM/ELM/FATES soil-hydraulic priors (VG/Clapp-Hornberger/Brooks-Corey). Treat macropore parameters as a first-class calibration axis.

discoveries.name: Decomposition is microbially-explicit with Johnson-Lewin-Eyring temperature (not Q10/CENTURY)
discoveries.description: 7 heterotroph + 6 autotroph functional groups across a 5-complex x 4-kinetic-component SOM structure; decomposition is linear in active colonized biomass. Temperature is JLE Arrhenius with low/high-T inactivation, not Q10.
discoveries.action: Seed decomposition priors from microbial-explicit models, NOT CENTURY-style CN/CNP. Nutrient mineralization is an emergent competition outcome, not a first-order rate.

discoveries.name: P sorption is Langmuir, not Freundlich
discoveries.description: Geochem uses rate forms with both sides of exchange in the denominator (Langmuir-style), relevant for P-limitation calibration.
discoveries.action: For P-limited sites, low plant P may be sorption-limited (soil PO4 unavailable) rather than uptake-kinetics-limited. Diagnose soil PO4 before tuning UPMXPO/UPKMPO.

discoveries.name: Stomatal conductance is turgor-based (not Ball-Berry/Medlyn)
discoveries.description: Stomatal resistance is solved from the CO2 diffusion equation with a turgor stress term exp(-PSICanopyTurg/RCS). Photosynthesis is a Farquhar-type biochemical model deriving Vcmax from leaf Rubisco/protein pools; source cites no Ball-Berry/Medlyn.
discoveries.action: There is no Ball-Berry g1 to calibrate. Water stress enters through canopy turgor (RSMX cuticular resistance, OSMO osmotic potential), coupling stomata to the Campbell hydraulics.

discoveries.name: Allocation is stage-prescribed with structural-N maintenance respiration (not PARTEH sink-source)
discoveries.description: CalcPartitionCoeff uses hard-coded partition fractions across 5 growth stages (e.g. 0.725 leaf / 0.275 petiole pre-floral-init). Maintenance respiration scales with structural N (ShootStructN) - nonstructural reserves do not pay maintenance. Opposite of FATES PARTEH-CNP.
discoveries.action: Calibrate allocation via the DM* dry-matter production ratios per growth stage, NOT a sink-source allocation prior. Maintenance-respiration sensitivity tracks structural N, not total biomass.

discoveries.name: EcoSIM caps plant species at JP=5 (compile-time)
discoveries.description: GridConsts.F90 sets JP=5 (max plant species) and JZ=20 (max soil layers) as compile-time parameter constants, not namelist-configurable. BioCON test1_ex1 uses 3 PFTs.
discoveries.action: A calibration cannot exceed 5 plant species without recompiling. Confirm the PFT count from the site pft input file (npfts) before ensemble design.

discoveries.name: growing_season_daytime_mean_abs REQUIRES the hourly tape; it is meaningless on the daily tape
discoveries.description: A daytime-windowed surface-CO2 (Fs) reduction cannot be computed from the daily history tape: the daily tape has already averaged the diel cycle away, so any hour-of-day selection on it is a no-op that silently returns the all-hours mean. The reducer therefore reads whichever tape the TARGET names (`tape: h1`) and hard-fails if the record count is not a multiple of 24.
discoveries.discovered_by: R3 c00 pre-flight tooling (2026-08-14); reducer implemented 2026-08-09
discoveries.source: models/ecosim/backend.py:658-690 (reads target['tape']; raises ValueError 'expects an hourly tape (24 records/day)'); reduction delegated to tools/subdaily_window_reduce.py::growing_season_window_mean_abs. VERIFIED by reading the code 2026-08-14.
discoveries.action: Never compute a scored daytime reduction outside the backend. Any analysis or plotting code must extract via backend.extract_history_variables(tape=target['tape']) and reduce through the same function the backend calls. A promoted plotting script that read the daily tape produced a plausible but wrong Fs on 2026-08-14.

discoveries.name: EcoSIM writes a REAL leap calendar, so fixed 365-record year blocking slips
discoveries.description: Year blocking must be leap-aware and anchored to a start year. Without an anchor the backend falls back to fixed 365-record years, warns, and then a window selection can fail outright rather than merely drift.
discoveries.source: models/ecosim/backend.py:723 RuntimeWarning ('fell back to a fixed 365 records/year: no start year') and the subsequent TypeError in _select_years:569 when blocks is None. VERIFIED by triggering it 2026-08-14 with A2MC_VALIDATION_START_YEAR unset.
discoveries.action: Always set A2MC_VALIDATION_START_YEAR (or a per-target start_year) before scoring. targets.yaml carries start_year on Fs but NOT on plant_C/NPP, so the env var is load-bearing.
